item.title: C++ Enum vs Enum Class: Key Differences and Safety Benefits
item.description:
“C++ Enum vs Enum Class: Key Differences and Safety Benefits”

The core differences revolve around type safety, namespace pollution, and implicit type conversions.

Scoping and Name Collision Avoidance

A significant advantage of enum class is how it handles the visibility of its enumerator names.

  • Plain Enums: Enumerator names are injected directly into the surrounding scope. If you define two plain enums with identical member names, you introduce a name clash, leading to compilation failures.
